intro: At the Stonefield homestead in south-central Elwynn Forest, “Auntie” Bernice Stonefield keeps watch over the neighborhood. Widowed when her husband fell in the kingdom’s military campaigns, she is known throughout the valley for her pork belly pies. She stays outside the farmhouse beside Ma Stonefield and remains deeply suspicious of the rival Maclure family.

p: Bernice carries the cost of war, as many common folk in the Kingdom of Stormwind do. Her husband fell in military campaigns, and she now lives with her kin at the family homestead. She helps Ma Stonefield manage the farm’s daily affairs, keeping the household fed and running. Her pork belly pies have made her famous among the people of the valley.
